content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"registered user","i_want":"to edit an existing task's title and Due Date in a form and save the changes","so_that":"my task list stays accurate when plans change","business_description":"Users can update a task after it is created. Edits go through the same form used for creation, with the current values pre-filled. The backend validates the changes and stores them only when the update succeeds.","business_value":"Keeps task data current so that the task list and report reflect the user's real plans.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores the new title, and the task shows the new title in the list only after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update, the stored title is unchanged, and the message 'Title is mandatory' is shown"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user enters a title of 101 characters and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error response","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns a success response","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"},{"given":"An update request is pending and the backend has not responded yet","when":"The form is shown while the request is pending","then":"No success message is displayed and the task list shows the previous values"},{"given":"An update request where the backend fails with a database error","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The frontend displays an error message, shows no success state, and the task list shows the previous values"}],"edge_cases":["A title empty. Open question: confirm whether a successful update sets Last Updated Date.","Two users or two browser tabs editing the same task at once: the PRD does not define conflict handling.
